title: Banana Quest: a browser foraging game driven by the full FlyWire whole-brain connectome (with a Chinese knowledge base on fly connectomics and whole-brain emulation)
description: Code is MIT (see LICENSE); the MIT license does not cover the bundled connectome data: FlyWire FAFB v783 data is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial only) and MaleCNS v1.0 data is CC BY 4.0. Zero-dependency browser game in which a leaky integrate-and-fire network over the real FlyWire FAFB v783 connectome (139,255 neurons) helps drive a foraging fly, with an optional MaleCNS v1.0 mode (176,422 neurons, with VNC). Includes a technical note (v6.0) auditing how data-packaging choices - transmitter sign tables, weight normalization, readout pools, seed sets - change simulated whole-brain dynamics, with byte-level equivalence checks, matched random controls, dose-response and weight-scheme experiments, all reproducible from frozen scripts; plus a Chinese knowledge base on fly connectomics and whole-brain emulation.
notes: Code MIT (LICENSE). Connectome data: FlyWire FAFB v783 CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); MaleCNS v1.0 CC BY 4.0. The deposit-level license field refers to the code only; see game/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for data terms and required citations.
